name: hcp
description: Plugins that expose a running coding-agent session over HCP, the Harness Control Protocol, so a phone or browser can watch it and answer its permission prompts.

plugins.name: hcp
plugins.description: Exposes this Claude Code session over HCP v0.1. Its PreToolUse hook is the permission channel, so a connected client answers the prompts for the session you are already sitting in.
